block.rationale: Dev-anvil pin captured at the moment start-forks.sh ran; FORK_BLOCK in the test matches exactly. Refork performed right before user handoff so the side-channel cross-check (Debank + PancakeSwap UI) sees minutes of drift, not hours.

pools.label: WETH/USDT 0.05%
pools.feeProtocol_note: 222825800 > uint8 max (255) — the high bits are set, so the inherited uint8 slot0 read reverts; the PancakeSwapV3PoolsMeta._slot0 override decodes it as uint32. This is the entire verification surface.

holders.label: ACTIVE_LP
notes: Holds one active (liquidity > 0) in-range WETH/USDT 0.05% position (NFT #22279) at the fork block.
One NFT exercises the full leg set the override touches: Supply on both tokens + Fees on both tokens.
The same wallet also FARMS NFT #22272 (staked into MasterChefV3) — NOT counted by this adapter; see findings.
The pool's NFTs churn between this wallet and MasterChefV3, so the ground-truth test discovers active positions dynamically rather than hardcoding tokenIds.

nfts_at_fork_block.branch: IN-RANGE (tickLower -203910 <= tickCurrent -202019 < tickUpper -198200) — principal on both tokens + fee delta on both

expected_per_pool.branch: in-range principal (both tokens) + fee delta (both tokens), no settled tokensOwed

ground_truth.method: on-chain protocol settlement (NOT a Python re-derivation)
ground_truth.detail: test_groundTruth_principalEqualsNpmSettlement burns each active NFT's liquidity via the real NonfungiblePositionManager.decreaseLiquidity at the fork block and asserts the adapter's reported Supply principal equals the returned (amount0, amount1) exactly. Same NPM bytecode, same archive state, same EVM — zero derivation drift. This mirrors the Uniswap V3 evidence pack (which also uses on-chain settlement, not Python); a Python re-derivation is reserved for closed-form adapters like Uniswap V2.

findings.title: Farmed positions not counted
findings.detail: PancakeSwap V3 farming transfers the LP NFT to MasterChefV3 (0x556B9306565093C855AEA9AE92A594704c2Cd59e). The adapter enumerates NPM.tokenOfOwnerByIndex(account), so a farmed NFT (owned by MasterChefV3) plus its pending CAKE is invisible. Example: this holder's NFT #22272 (~$5,597 + CAKE) is missed; NFT #22279 (~$698) is counted. Needs a dedicated MasterChefV3 farm adapter.

findings.title: protocolId was uniswap-v3
findings.detail: Inherited PROTOCOL_ID tagged PCS V3 positions as uniswap-v3 while ProtocolIds.PANCAKESWAP_V3 was unused and the identity docs already specified pancakeswap-v3. Fixed by making _protocolId() virtual on the Uniswap metas and overriding it in the PancakeSwap subclasses (V2 -> pancakeswap-v2, V3 -> pancakeswap-v3).
